name: Supabase
summary: Postgres database, sign-in and row-level security in one hosted service. The default for Lovable, Bolt and v0 projects, and what Lovable Cloud runs on.
bestFor: Most sites: bookings, orders, enquiries and an editable menu, with a generous free tier.
cost: Free tier for small sites; paid from about $25 a month per project.
tested: Tested 21 October 2026 on the local Supabase stack: 64 access checks across public, stranger, staff, manager and owner, plus the sign-in and bookings screens end to end with middleware.ts and proxy.ts.
